pairs.old: function draw(){const q=qs[index%qs.length];qEl.textContent=q.q;oEl.innerHTML='';q.o.forEach((x,i)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='equation-option';b.textContent=x;b.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!gameActive)return;if(i===q.a){b.classList.add('good');setScore(score+15+(gameLevel==='godhood'?8:0));setStatus('Correct · next equation.');}else{b.classList.add('bad');setStatus('Not quite · keep the model clean.');}setTimeout(()=>{index++;draw();},330);});oEl.appendChild(b);});}
